rca of the issue: Root cause for UI leak: SOURCE_LABELS map lacks key 'operation_payment_income', so labelFromMap falls back to raw key display. Mitigation: add key to SOURCE_LABELS (and audit all source values from /api/finance/journal-entries against map coverage).
